summary: Tested AI Virtual Fitting Room (new feature) end-to-end on backend and frontend. Backend: added 7 new pytest cases under TestTryOn covering auth protection, model create+list, file serving via httpOnly cookie + ?token= query, cross-user 403 isolation, generate+poll until completion with Nano Banana (gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview), gallery listing, and delete. All 32/32 pytest tests pass (previous 25 + new 7). Full generate pipeline completed in ~15s for 2 frames. Frontend Playwright E2E: /fitting-room protected (redirects to / when logged out), registration via auth modal works, session persists across hard reload (Bearer tg_token in localStorage + httpOnly cookie), upload-photos-input (hidden) accepts 2 PNGs via set_input_files, save-model-btn persists model and auto-selects it, 8 garments render, generate-tryon-btn triggers tryon-loading then tryon-result with result-spin-viewer + spin-play-toggle, gallery tab lists the saved look with gallery-spin-* viewer, gallery-delete-* removes item (count 1 -> 0). try-on-btn on product detail navigates to /fitting-room?product=<id>. Regression: live header search debounces to /catalog?search=parka returning the single matching card.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _process_tryon_job: catches per-frame exceptions and sets result=None, but if garment image download fails upfront the job is marked 'failed' silently with no error message surfaced to GET /tryon/jobs/{id} response (frontend only sees status flip). Consider returning last_error so the UI can show a reason.

server.py serve_tryon_file: supports cookie OR Authorization OR ?token= — good. But the token is leaked in server access logs via querystring. Consider logging-filter or short-lived signed URLs for production.

FittingRoom.jsx polls GET /api/tryon/jobs/{id} every 3s with no exponential backoff and no explicit stop on component unmount shown — ensure the interval is cleaned up on route change to avoid orphaned polls (minor).
CameraCapture.jsx upload-photos-input is className='hidden' (correct for a11y label pattern) — Playwright must use state='attached' when awaiting it; documented for next testing agent.
MAX_FRAMES=12 but no frontend validation caps user uploads before POST — large uploads currently truncated silently server-side. Consider a client-side slice + warn.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@telluricgaia.com / TelluricAdmin#2026 (not required for try-on; tests register ephemeral TEST_* customers).
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_tryon_*@example.com and TEST_fe_*@example.com customers plus one tryon_model + tryon_job per backend session (job deleted in test_delete_gallery). Frontend E2E also created one model + one gallery item then deleted it. Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fitting Room testids: fitting-room-page, fitting-tab-{create|gallery}, upload-photos-input (HIDDEN — use state='attached' with set_input_files, NOT click), capture-preview, save-model-btn, model-card-, garment- (8 products), generate-tryon-btn (disabled until model+garment selected; use wait_for_function on !disabled), tryon-loading, tryon-result, result-spin-viewer, spin-play-toggle, gallery-item-, gallery-spin-, gallery-delete-, try-on-btn (ProductDetail). Live camera (open-camera-btn) cannot be automated headless — always use upload path. Nano Banana per-frame ~8-15s, 2 frames ~15-30s total; poll up to 180s. mediaUrl() in lib/api.js appends ?token= to /tryon/file URLs so renders without cookies on hard reload. Delete uses browser confirm() dialog — register page.once('dialog', accept) before clicking.
rca of the issue: No defects discovered. One testing-script-only snag: upload-photos-input is `className=hidden` so Playwright's default wait_for_selector (state=visible) times out — resolved by using state='attached'. All backend try-on endpoints and the full UI pipeline (model -> generate -> spin viewer -> gallery -> delete) and the ProductDetail -> /fitting-room?product=<id> deep link work exactly as specified.
